operating_point.power_note: At fixed 15 A, the corrected CCM source model reports 1617.083 W, 1796.416 W and 1975.751 W input at 108/120/132 Vrms. These are fixed-input screening points; 1796.416 W is not a delivered-output requirement.
operating_point.current_source: loss-budget/evidence/correction-02/loss-report.json, L=180 uH cases 2, 8, 14; Rust pfc_switching model, not measured waveform

controller_gate.fault_behavior: GATE disabled on controller UVLO and VOUT over-voltage protection; no exposed FAULT pin in this 8-pin device
controller_gate.source: TI UCC28180 Rev D, SLUSBQ5D, pp. 6-7 and p. 26

interface_contract.signal_wiring: UCC28180 GATE -> existing 10 ohm input resistor -> driver IN; driver OUT -> new gate resistor -> MOSFET G. Move the 10 kohm pulldown to driver OUT/G. Do not connect UCC28180 GATE directly to the replacement MOSFET gate.
common_requirements: Driver IN must remain below its absolute maximum for the UCC28180 15.2 V typical / 16.1 V specified test-point high; verify the actual UCC28180 GATE high during startup, shutdown and ringing.

Driver EN must be explicitly sequenced or held low until controller VCC is valid; both selected drivers default EN enabled through an internal pull-up. Driver input pulldown keeps OUT low only if the GATE net is quiet.
Use Kelvin-source TO-247-4: driver return and MOSFET driver-source pin are a short loop; power-source pin alone carries boost current back to the shunt.
Place 0.1 uF and >=1 uF ceramic VDD bypass at the driver. Keep driver-MOSFET-VDD capacitor loop short and separate power return from controller signal return.

Tune turn-on and turn-off gate resistance independently where possible. A stronger driver is a controlled experiment, not automatic evidence of lower total loss: capture VGS, VDS, IDS, overshoot, ringing and EMI at each resistor value.

mosfet.technology: 650 V CoolSiC M1 trench SiC MOSFET

rds_on_ohm.hot_note: Datasheet gives 175 C typical and a normalized RDS(on) curve (p. 9); 100/125 C values were not extracted as guaranteed numbers.

eoss.condition: 400 V typical; curve required to map to 389.615 V

driver.enable: active high; EN internal pull-up 200 kohm; hold low for fail-safe startup
driver.polarity: dual independent non-inverting channels; one channel used
driver.source: TI UCC27624 Rev E, SLUSE44E (revised 2026-03), pp. 1, 4-8, 25-26

bias_and_gate_network.required_change: Add a regulated 18 V gate-driver bias rail (or a verified 18 V isolated bias source) and clamp/verify the IMZA gate below 20 V including ringing. UCC28180 GATE remains a 15 V-class logic signal into UCC27624 INA.
bias_and_gate_network.gate_resistor_basis: Infineon KIT_1EDB_AUX_SiC application note uses unipolar 18 V and 6.8 ohm on/off resistors for IMZA65R048M1H at 16 A; final value must be tuned on the actual loop.
bias_and_gate_network.input_pulldown: UCC27624 internal 120 kohm plus external 10 kohm at driver OUT/G

loss_screen_w.method: Pcond = I_switch_rms^2 * RDS(on); Pgate_network = Qg * Vdrive * fSW. Overlap and Eoss are not added without a matched curve/waveform.
loss_screen_w.driver_static_bias: UCC27624 0.6-1.0 mA static at 12 V no-load; 18 V value and loaded gate current need measurement. Do not add full Qg*V*f again as controller quiescent loss.

availability.driver_source: DigiKey UCC27624DR observed 1038 in stock, $1.46 cut-tape; indicative cached result

qualification_blockers: No 18 V bias producer is present in elec/src/power_entry_unit.ato; existing AUX_15V is not enough for the manufacturer's recommended 18 V turn-on.
Measure input high at UCC27624 INA over UCC28180 startup/UVLO/OVP and ensure no input overshoot beyond 26 V or negative transient below -10 V.

Double-pulse test at 389.6 V over measured instantaneous drain-current range at switching instants (including ripple and line-phase peak); do not use duty-weighted RMS moments as DPT setpoints. Gate sweep; hot RDS(on) at controlled 25/100/125 C fixture states; thermal and EMI capture.
Reject if regulated gate reaches >20 V at the IMZA source pin or if the Kelvin-source/power-source routing is not physically separated.

mosfet.screen_vgs_note: 15 V is the RDS(on) datasheet test point, not a manufacturer-recommended turn-on voltage; the specified operating range is -5 V to +18 V.

rds_on_ohm.hot_note: Datasheet gives 18 V typ at 175 C; no guaranteed 100/125 C points were used.

eoss.condition: No directly matched Eoss point retained for 389.615 V

switching_reference.condition: 400 V, 20 A, -5/18 V, RG=2.2 ohm; source test point, not PFC loss

driver.enable: active high; EN internal pull-up 200 kohm; hold low for fail-safe startup
driver.polarity: dual independent non-inverting channels; one channel used

bias_and_gate_network.required_change: Add driver SOIC-8, VDD decoupling and a Kelvin-source TO-247-4 MOSFET footprint. Existing 15 V bias is within UCC27524A and NTH4L060N065SC1 specified VGS operating limits; prove AUX_15V regulation and gate overshoot.
bias_and_gate_network.gate_resistor_basis: onsemi datasheet switching reference uses RG=2.2 ohm at 400 V/20 A; final value must be tuned for this boost loop and EMI.
bias_and_gate_network.input_pulldown: UCC27524A input pulldown plus external 10 kohm at driver OUT/G

loss_screen_w.method: Pcond = I_switch_rms^2 * RDS(on); Pgate_network = Qg * Vdrive * fSW. Eon/Eoff source point is shown separately and is not combined with unknown PFC overlap/Eoss.
loss_screen_w.source_point_note: 8.133766 W = (45+18) uJ * 129107.39198577 Hz at the datasheet's 400 V/20 A test point; it is not a PFC loss estimate and must not be added to an independently measured Eon/Eoff or Eoss term.

availability.driver_source: DigiKey UCC27524AD observed 5212 in stock, $2.97 tube qty1; indicative cached result

qualification_blockers: Existing controller GATE high must stay below UCC27524A input limits; characterize positive and negative transients rather than relying on nominal 15 V.
NTH4L060N065SC1 is 4-pin; using the existing TO-247-3 footprint or tying Kelvin and power source together loses the intended switching benefit and can increase gate bounce.

Double-pulse and PFC waveform tests must use measured instantaneous switching current (not the loss report's RMS moments) at controlled 25/100/125 C fixture states; verify gate-high voltage and the distinct Miller plateau at the proposed 15 V supply, RDS(on), drain overshoot and conducted/radiated EMI.
Reject if UCC27524A VDD drops below UVLO during AUX startup or if EN default-on can produce a gate pulse before controller GATE is proven low.

reproduction.scope: Reproduces only the reported I^2R and Qg*V*f arithmetic from retained switch-RMS inputs; it is not a second PFC solver.
